# Dashboard dependencies

Locally vendored upstream distributions. No CDN or telemetry is used.
See the adjacent LICENSE files before redistribution.

- Three.js 0.186.1: version also recorded in `three/three.core.js` (REVISION), MIT.
  `three.module.js`, `three.core.js`, `OrbitControls.js`: npm package `three`.
- Lucide 1.52.0: `lucide.min.js`, npm package `lucide`, ISC with MIT portions;
  its combined upstream LICENSE is included.

Only these unmodified upstream files are vendored; no premium assets from
the reference videos are included.
